discovery: Theoretical prediction and experimental discovery of topological insulators
rationale: Topological insulators are a mature condensed-matter breakthrough that has long been tipped for the prize. It builds on the 2016 topology prize, and both the theory (Kane-Mele Z2 invariant, quantum spin Hall effect) and the experiment (Molenkamp's HgTe quantum wells) are well established. Shoucheng Zhang's death leaves a clear three-person citation. The rotation away from astrophysics and AI also leaves room for condensed-matter physics.
